condition_for_pass: Priority eligibility is score_eligible and the priority score was not suppressed by an override.
business_reasoning: Only a valid, unique, in-scope lead in a routable state may be offered to an RM.

condition_for_pass: The lead is not in an unresolved duplicate group at the decision instant.
business_reasoning: An unresolved duplicate must never reach an RM because two RMs would work the same prospect.

condition_for_pass: The lead is not in VALIDATION_PENDING at the decision instant.
business_reasoning: A record that fails validation cannot be worked and must be corrected by the capturing channel first.

condition_for_pass: Geography status is resolved_cma or resolved_province_remainder (not out_of_footprint).
business_reasoning: A business that does not operate in Canada is outside the hypothetical bank's footprint.

condition_for_pass: The lead has a resolved territory_id at the decision instant.
business_reasoning: Routing cannot start before geography resolves to exactly one territory.

condition_for_pass: Employment started on or before the decision date and has not ended on or before it, and the RM record is active.
business_reasoning: A departed or not-yet-joined RM cannot own a lead.

condition_for_pass: Availability status in the as-of capacity snapshot is available or partial (not planned_leave or unavailable). When no snapshot exists the rule is not evaluated, because availability is then unknown rather than bad; REL-12 is the rule that fails.
business_reasoning: An RM on leave or absent cannot make first contact within the SLA. An unknown availability is a missing-evidence problem and must be reported as one.

condition_for_pass: The RM holds an rm_territory row for the lead's territory whose effective period contains the decision date; or, under the TER-10 national fallback, effective coverage of the national specialist territory together with the required primary specialization. valid_to and employment_end_date are exclusive bounds, as the synthetic source shows (the last capacity snapshot for a leaver is strictly before employment_end_date, and no assignment is made on or after either date).
business_reasoning: Territory responsibility is a control in the hypothetical design and is dated. The national pool exists so a mandatory-specialist lead is not stranded where the region has no specialist.

condition_for_pass: For remote_service and national_specialist lead territories only RMs holding that pool's coverage are eligible. The TER-10 national specialist fallback is a second stage: it admits national-pool specialists only when the decision has no eligible regional candidate, so a national-pool RM never competes with an eligible regional RM on preference.
business_reasoning: Remote and national work is served by named pools rather than by regional coverage; the national pool is a fallback, not a competitor.

condition_for_pass: For a mandatory-specialist industry the RM holds an effective primary specialization in that industry on the decision date.
business_reasoning: Agriculture and commercial real estate leads must be owned by a specialist; a generalist needs an approved override.

condition_for_pass: When the prospect explicitly stated a service language, the RM's supported_service_languages contain it. Language is never inferred.
business_reasoning: Only an explicitly stated language may be used; inferring language from a name or location is prohibited.

condition_for_pass: A capacity snapshot exists for the RM with snapshot_as_of_utc at or before the decision instant.
business_reasoning: Without a valid as-of snapshot the decision cannot be made on evidence, so the lead is held rather than guessed.

condition_for_pass: Utilization ratio in the as-of snapshot is strictly below the hard limit of 1.00.
business_reasoning: An ordinary assignment must never push an RM past the declared hard limit.

condition_for_pass: On a reassignment decision the RM who owns the lead immediately before the decision is excluded; on any decision an RM who previously declined this lead is excluded.
business_reasoning: Reassignment exists to move the lead away from its current owner; a declined lead must not return to the same RM.
